notes: Lines on this map: thin (2-3 px) lines are block outlines, one closed rectangle per block; heavy (5-7 px) lines are zoning borders. Here the heavy borders never sit on a block's thin outline: they run down the middle of streets or through blocks along lot lines, jogging in stair-steps round lots (e.g. the RM-1 band through blocks 1443/1442/1440/1439 at x 1720-1865, the RH-1/RH-3 steps at x 1270-1430 y 1630-2080), and some cross streets to enclose parts of two blocks. A block is told by its thin rectangle, which runs unbroken under and across every heavy border; a heavy border is never a block edge here. Box: four columns of blocks (A x 1238-1436, B 1457-1654, C 1689-1884, D 1907- past the box's east side) by eight rows (row 0 cut by the box's top at y 1310, rows 1-7 whole); 32 blocks, all plain rectangles. Column B (blocks 1533-1539): the heavy C-2 border at x 1617-1625 runs through every block about 30 px in from its east (Geary) side; the thin line at x 1650-1654 closes the block, so each is ONE block from x 1457 to 1654, not a block plus a strip (the column is the same 197 px wide as A and C). The heavy P (park) boxes round 1538 (x 1526-1582, y 1880-1990), 1641 (x 1760-1830, y 1585-1700) and 1439 (x 1840-1872, y 1790-1840) stick out across the street lines; they are zoning, not block outlines. Lettering in the streets (AVE., CLEMENT ST., C-2, RM-1, RH-1(D)) is street. No open land in the box. Corner positions read off the 4x ruled close-ups and set to the outer edge of each thin line with dark-pixel line profiles across each row and column of blocks (lines drift about 3 px across the box, so each block takes its own values).
